# Vespera Caviar — llms.txt

## About

Vespera Caviar is a luxury caviar house based in New York City. We source
sustainably farmed sturgeon roe and sell it directly to consumers — malossol-
cured, never frozen, packed to order, and shipped overnight in a temperature-
controlled case. There is no retail storefront. Every tin goes directly from
our facility to the customer's door.

## Products

We offer three caviar selections:

### Siberian Sturgeon Classic
- Species: Acipenser baerii
- Pearl size: Medium (dark grey to jet-black)
- Flavor: Nutty, earthy, slightly spicy finish. Firm, satisfying pop.
- Use: Versatile everyday luxury. Pairs with blinis, crème fraîche, champagne.
- Sizes: 1 oz, 2 oz
- URL: https://vesperacaviar.com/siberian

### Kaluga Fusion Reserve
- Species: Kaluga (Huso dauricus) × Amur sturgeon hybrid
- Pearl size: Large (deep olive to brown)
- Flavor: Rich butteriness, subtle sweetness, complex nutty finish. Clean briny elegance.
- Use: Sophisticated yet approachable. Ideal with dry Champagne or as a tasting centerpiece.
- Sizes: 1 oz, 2 oz
- URL: https://vesperacaviar.com/kaluga

### Imperial Kaluga Fusion
- Species: Kaluga × Amur, top selection
- Pearl size: Oversized, firm, deeply colored
- Flavor: Intensely creamy and buttery, long lingering finish, refined nutty depth.
- Comparison: Often likened to classic Beluga in character.
- Use: Special occasions, connoisseurs. Serve simply on ice with mother-of-pearl.
- Sizes: 1 oz, 2 oz
- URL: https://vesperacaviar.com/imperial

## Standards

- **Cure**: Malossol (lightly salted, ≤5% salt) — traditional method
- **Frozen**: Never. All tins ship fresh.
- **Sustainability**: Sourced exclusively from responsible, traceable sturgeon farms
- **Stock**: Packed to order, never held in inventory

## Shipping

- Ships from: New York, NY
- Method: Overnight, temperature-controlled insulated case
- Storage on arrival: 28–32°F, coldest part of refrigerator
- Shelf life (unopened): Best-by date on tin base, typically 2–3 weeks from packing
- After opening: Consume within 2–3 days, keep sealed on ice

## Ordering

Orders are placed via the Private Client enquiry form or by email. There is no
self-checkout e-commerce system at this time.

- Enquiry form: https://vesperacaviar.com/contact
- Email: concierge@vesperacaviar.com
- Wholesale / events: Available via Private Client desk

## Contact

- Email: concierge@vesperacaviar.com
- Location: New York, NY, USA
- Response time: Within one business day
